cases.name: depth-positive
cases.tradeoff: L3 requires Worker construction, lifecycle listener, stream/promises pipeline, termination, and try/finally cleanup in the same function component; wrapper and split orchestration is missed.

cases.name: one-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: One required high-precision signal is absent; the depth rule must fail closed.

cases.name: vendored-composition
cases.tradeoff: Vendored source belongs to a dependency and is excluded before parsing.
